overview: A test token sale site for TTTI-T, a one-token live test of the future 10,000-token TTTI, with buying, transfers, ledger history and a white paper aligned with the contract code.
features: Buy TTTI-T with ICP at the hourly rate
Send TTTI-T to other accounts; transfers to the contract address are refused
Tokens cannot be burned; collected transfer fees are issued again against ICP
Ledger history including records from earlier test versions
Technical details with the real controllers and module hash
Corrected white paper with the original kept as an archive
FAQ including how purchase and transfer data is recorded
